framework.name: Hook-Problem-Thesis-CTA (myth-bust / hot take)
framework.description: Relatable question hook, names the 'trend trap', blames imitation, states the creator-truth thesis, then a comment-keyword CTA.

label it 'the trend trap in a nutshell'

structure.purpose: you clone another creator's look and wonder why it never clicks

comment keyword for the full guide, then end card
